description: Réseau cyclable is a dataset listed in Open Data Mons, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Mons. Ce jeu de données reprend l'ensemble des pistes cyclables présentes sur le territoire de la commune de Mons, en précisant si celles-ci sont uni ou bi-directionnelles. ← Retour au catalogue complet. Coverage: Mons. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Mobilité douce, Santé, Réseau, Vélo. The portal shows 293 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-mons-be-portal.
